plan.title: Verify native Windows cancellation, recovery and local pre-push boundaries

criteria.description: Same-check concurrent execution cannot replace running authority; native Windows job must directly observe test-owned child/grandchild handles across context cancellation and timeout, reject prior pass/restart until inspected cleanup, preserve affected state and successfully recover. Record actual surviving-process limits, not complete cleanup support.

Actual installed pre-push hook on native Windows must reject missing/stale/unverified/narrowed-mode refs and create only the passing ref in an isolated temporary local bare remote. Explicit opt-in run is required before closure, with no skipped acceptance cases. Keep P08 paths passing.

limitations: Windows-specific integration tests run separately on approved GitHub hosted amd64 runner; local code-v1 does not prove Windows runtime. No arbitrary PID kills, production/network push fixture or automatic owner recovery. Full descendant termination implementation is outside scope.
